hazards.evidence: No visible throw rugs, but the room has a large expanse of unsecured wooden flooring that could be slippery for someone using a walker.
The blue recliner and beige sofa lack armrests at the point of sitting or standing, which may make it difficult for someone recovering from surgery to rise safely.
The right-side sofa lacks armrests at the edge, which may hinder safe transfers.
The lighting appears adequate, but glare from the large windows could pose a minor issue.
Although not a bedroom, the living area has tight spaces between furniture that may restrict walker clearance.
